embeds.title: ARTICLE XVI — COMPETITIVE INTEGRITY AND ANTI-TANKING
embeds.description:
Managers are expected to compete in good faith and maintain legal, reasonably competitive lineups.

Prohibited conduct includes deliberate lineup sabotage, collusion, coordinated dumping of assets, or manipulation intended to distort standings, playoff qualification, or draft position.

Where the league uses **Max PF** or a similar anti-tanking measure for draft-order purposes, Fantrax and the league’s published annual draft-order procedure control.

Temporary lineup decisions, rebuilding strategies, and lopsided-looking trades do not by themselves establish misconduct.
